caption: Plan and billing on the free plan: 3 of 3 free documents left this month, with the paid plans below; the account initial is hidden.
Recipients step with three made up signers; the email column is hidden and the VerySecure palm scan box can be ticked per signer.
Review and send with VerySecure ticked for 1 of 3 signers on the free plan: 'VerySecure requires a paid subscription. Ordinary documents remain available within your free plan's allowance.'
Review and send for one PDF to three signers: 'Uses 1 of your 3 remaining free documents', with the limit of 10 recipients per document and 25 in any 24 hours; the email column is hidden.
Plan and billing after the send: 2 of 3 free documents left this month, so three signers cost one document; the account initial is hidden.
Review and send for the corrected version: 'Uses 1 of your 2 remaining free documents', so a correction costs a new document; the email column is hidden.
The page a signer opens from the invitation without any login: the document name, the items to give (signature and full name) and the three participants; the sender line is hidden.
Reading mode on the same page ('Reading only. Ready to sign?'): the synthetic test document can be read before agreeing to anything.
Plan and billing after cancelling both requests: still 1 of 3 free documents left this month, so cancelling gives nothing back; the account initial is hidden.
